parameters.description:
`msg-to-smseagle-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SMS Eagle device — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SMS Eagle devices — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SMS Eagle devices bound per enrollment.

SMSEagle is a physical SMS/MMS gateway appliance; connect to its own web interface and generate an access token there — set that as SMSEAGLE_SMS_TOKEN. Set SMSEAGLE_SMS_TARGETS to a plain phone number, an @-prefixed contact, or a #-prefixed group already configured on the device (public groups only).
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SMSEagle destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your SMSEagle device JSON-RPC API
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own SMS Eagle device by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

base_url.description: This enrollment's SMSEAGLE_SMS_BASE_URL value (same format as SMSEAGLE_SMS_BASE_URL). Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

targets.description: This enrollment's SMS Eagle targets. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.

token.description: This enrollment's SMS Eagle token. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
